reasoning: According to official U.S. Treasury data and reports from the U.S. House Committee on the Budget, the U.S. national debt (Total Public Debt Outstanding) officially surpassed $34 trillion in late December 2023. Subsequent reporting and Treasury datasets confirm that total debt has continued to rise beyond $34 trillion since that time.
